name: tollkeep
description: Tollkeep — the policy and approval layer above every agent payment rail

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c gold,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w web && playwright test
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e
